tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content (the body gradient, averaged). Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (15.0:1).

tokens.name: page-surface
tokens.usage: Surface most of the page's running text sits on (cards, panels).

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: Heritage foundation, timeless depth. Used as background on `.watch-image::after`.

tokens.name: rose-gold
tokens.usage: Luxury warmth, precious metal elegance. Used as text on `nav a.active`, `.stat-change`, `.watch-price`; background on `.status-dot`. 3.3:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Aged parchment, vintage refinement. Used as text on `.logo-text h1`, `nav a:hover`, `.table-header h3`. 1.0:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: platinum
tokens.usage: Precision craftsmanship, Swiss quality. Used as text on `.logo-text p`, `.watch-image`, `.footer-bottom p`. 1.6:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: neutral-light
tokens.usage: Refined backgrounds, paper textures. Used as text on `nav a`, `.footer-section p`, `.footer-links a`; background on `.btn-secondary:hover`. 1.1:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: bg-primary
tokens.usage: Aged parchment, vintage refinement. Used as background on `body`.

tokens.name: bg-card
tokens.usage: Used as background on `.category-tag`; border on `.category-tag`; text on `.category-tag`. 1.1:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Heritage foundation, timeless depth. Used as text on `body`, `h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6`, `.stat-value`. 15.0:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: accent-primary
tokens.usage: Luxury warmth, precious metal elegance. Used as text on `.text-accent`. 3.3:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: accent-secondary
tokens.usage: Precision craftsmanship, Swiss quality. Used as background on `body`, `.stat-icon`, `.material-badge`; border on `.footer-bottom`.
